name: Fringe
author: Erin Carter
description: Two unseen exciters pinch a dark glass sheet; their summed standing waves glow in lozenge fringes while hyperbolic nodal curves stay pinned and black. A hash-scheduled strike floods the figure with shimmer, then it rings down toward stillness — nothing travels, only brightness lives and dies.

params.label: Source split
params.effect: CSS-px distance between the two exciter points, from tight near-circular fringes to wide sweeping hyperbolae.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: CSS-px wavelength of the standing field, setting how finely the fringe orders pack.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between strikes that re-flood (and occasionally re-place) the fringe system.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: Decay constant of the shared envelope, from quick damping to a slow dying shimmer.
